items.title: Harold Christophe Interview, 1961-08-01
items.q: Now Dave and Richardson, about the two oldest men and I think Cal, yeah them three about the oldest men from the St. John Band.

ctx.x: Oh, I see. It was from the St. John and it went into the Gibson Band?

Well, some of the men, like Dave was there. Dave was there. Yeah, Dave was one of the original men from the St. John Band. Now Dave and Richardson, about the two oldest men and I think Cal, yeah them three about the oldest men from the St. John Band. Yeah, but the rest of the fellas are all newcomers. Uh-huh. Yeah.
Well now, that would be about a ten piece band like we use now?
